problem.title: Design Underground System
problem.statement:
An underground railway system is keeping track of customer travel times between different stations. They are using this data to calculate the average time it takes to travel from one station to another.

You will process a sequence of operations of three types:

- checkIn(id, stationName, t): A customer with card ID equal to id checks in at station stationName at time t. A customer can only be checked into one place at a time.
- checkOut(id, stationName, t): A customer with card ID equal to id checks out from station stationName at time t.
- getAverageTime(startStation, endStation): Returns the average time it takes to travel from startStation to endStation. The average time is computed from all previous traveling times from startStation to endStation that happened directly, meaning a check in at startStation followed by a check out from endStation. The time from startStation to endStation may be different from the time from endStation to startStation. There will be at least one customer that has traveled from startStation to endStation before getAverageTime is called.

You may assume all calls to checkIn and checkOut are consistent. If a customer checks in at time t1 then checks out at time t2, then t1 < t2. All events happen in chronological order.

**Input:**
The first line contains an integer n, the number of operations.
The next n lines each describe one operation:
- "checkIn id stationName t"
- "checkOut id stationName t"
- "getAverageTime startStation endStation"

**Output:**
For each getAverageTime operation, print one line containing the average travel time with exactly 5 decimal places. No output is produced for checkIn or checkOut operations.

**Constraints:**
- 1 <= id, t <= 10^6
- 1 <= stationName.length, startStation.length, endStation.length <= 10
- All station names consist of uppercase and lowercase English letters and digits.
- There will be at most 2 * 10^4 operations in total.
- Answers within 10^-5 of the actual value will be accepted.

**Examples:**
Example 1:
Input:
12
checkIn 45 Leyton 3
checkIn 32 Paradise 8
checkIn 27 Leyton 10
checkOut 45 Waterloo 15
checkOut 27 Waterloo 20
checkOut 32 Cambridge 22
getAverageTime Paradise Cambridge
getAverageTime Leyton Waterloo
checkIn 10 Leyton 24
getAverageTime Leyton Waterloo
checkOut 10 Waterloo 38
getAverageTime Leyton Waterloo
Output:
14.00000
11.00000
11.00000
12.00000

Example 2:
Input:
9
checkIn 10 Leyton 3
checkOut 10 Paradise 8
getAverageTime Leyton Paradise
checkIn 5 Leyton 10
checkOut 5 Paradise 16
getAverageTime Leyton Paradise
checkIn 2 Leyton 21
checkOut 2 Paradise 30
getAverageTime Leyton Paradise
Output:
5.00000
5.50000
6.66667
